title: LookFigures
description: Data file content/look/figures.json: how the appearance record of an inhabitant (core, B2 R27) becomes a figure: body model per age stage and sex, hair mesh per hair style, sleeves and leg length per clothing style, shoe colour and the model heights for scaling. Presentation only, not part of the hash. Values are placeholders.

outline.description: Whether figures get the ink outline pass.

idle_slot_spread.description: How much an inhabitant's idle slot is longer or shorter than pose_cadence.idle_slot_s (share, e.g. 0.3 = up to 30 percent either way); with a phase per inhabitant it keeps figures from changing their idle behaviour in lock-step.

walk_min_step_m.description: Least ground distance in metres an inhabitant must move in a tick to be shown walking (whatever the action; actions walk to their target first).

turn_rate_deg_s.description: How fast a figure turns towards where it walks, in degrees per real second.

turn_back_after_steps.description: A walking figure whose step points backwards (more than 90 degrees from its facing, e.g. when it gives way on a narrow path, W1726) turns round only from this many such steps in a row; a step forward in between resets the count, a first step after standing turns at once. Absent = 1 (every step turns the figure).

gait_time_scale.description: Range of the gait playback factor: the gait clips play faster or slower so the feet roughly match the on-screen speed, but never beyond this range (calm world, B2466).

head_anchor_m.description: Height of the head anchor above the feet at scale 1 (thought bubble, question mark).

thinking_dots.description: Calm thought dots above the head while an inhabitant has an open question (presentation only).

clothing_parts.description: Clothing parts as meshes on the rig (F4): which mesh, which clothing colour, and which body regions it hides (those take its colour, so the body never shows through; uncovered regions are skin).

gestures.description: Arm gestures over the running pose (D958 D2): the first gesture whose action and reach fit the shown action clip moves the arms by two-bone IK. Frame, not outcome: the core says what is done, this only shows it.

sitting.description: Seated clips only sit on something (W1688): on a seat object near the figure the hips go to its seat height; elsewhere the figure sits on the ground with straightened legs, never in the air.

lying.description: Lying poses (W1695, W1729): sleeping figures sit down and lie on their side on the ground, fitted to it.

greeting.description: How inhabitants show that they heard the player (W1688): they look up and turn to the voice (the camera), the speaker waves or talks with its answer.

silhouette.description: Inhabitants stay visible (W1689): where a tree, rock or object hides a figure, its silhouette is drawn through in the inhabitant's colour.

crown_fade.description: Tree crowns between the camera and the followed inhabitant fade semi-transparent (W1689).

FigureGesture.description: One arm gesture: a calm cycle of reach out (rise), stay at the start point (dip), move to the head (lift), hold, lower and rest. Points are in the figure's own frame in metres for a figure of size 1 (x towards the arm's own side, y up, z forward), so one set of numbers serves both arms.

actions.description: Core actions the gesture shows (vocabulary actions).

reach.description: Only for targets of these reach heights (look objects 'reach'); missing = any, also without a target.

rise_s.description: Real seconds the arm needs to reach its first point.

dip_s.description: Real seconds at the start point before the hands move to the head (0 or missing: straight to the head).

lift_s.description: Real seconds from the start point to the head.

hold_s.description: Real seconds the hand stays at the head (mouth).

lower_s.description: Real seconds back to the pose of the clip.

rest_s.description: Real seconds before the next cycle (chewing, swallowing).

influence.description: How strongly the gesture overrides the clip at its peak (0..1).

to_head.description: Target of the hand relative to the head bone (metres, figure frame), e.g. in front of the mouth.

from_body.description: Start point relative to the figure's root (metres, figure frame), e.g. the water in front of the knees; missing: none, the hand goes to the head at once.

pole.description: Where the elbow points, relative to the figure's root (metres, figure frame), for the right arm.

FigureLying.description: Lying down to sleep (W1695, W1729), a placeholder until the figures have a lying clip: the figure sits down on the ground with the library's sit transition (sit_clip over sit_s), then rolls from sitting onto its side about its hips (roll_deg over roll_s, eased) while the hips slide to the lying spot and the legs open a little; the lying clips play their seated loop laid on its side. The lying body follows the ground: tilted to the slope under it (at most max_tilt_deg) and lifted so that no sampled body point is below the ground. Getting up is the same in reverse and ends with rise_clip. A lying figure never turns its body to a voice or to another inhabitant.

clips.description: Library clip ids played lying (e.g. sleep); their asset is a seated loop.

sit_clip.description: Library clip id of the transition from standing to sitting, played first when lying down.

rise_clip.description: Library clip id of the transition from sitting to standing, played last when getting up.

sit_s.description: Real seconds of sitting down and of standing up; the transition clips are played at the speed that fits them into it.

sink_from.description: Share of sit_s at which the hips begin to sink to the ground (as in the sit transition clip).

sink_to.description: Share of sit_s at which the hips have reached the ground; greater than sink_from.

roll_s.description: Real seconds of the eased roll from sitting onto the side, and back.

roll_deg.description: Roll about the figure's facing axis through its hips in degrees: -90 lays it on its left side with the head to its left, 90 on its right side.

hip_back_m.description: How far the hips of the seated pose are behind the figure's origin in metres at scale 1.

hip_slide_m.description: How far the hips slide away from the side the head goes down to while rolling, in metres at scale 1, so the lying body is centred on its spot.

legs_from.description: Share of the roll after which the legs leave the seated pose (thighs open, knees bend): late, while the body is nearly down, so the legs do not dip into the ground.

hip_open.description: How far the thighs open from the seated pose towards straight legs while lying (0 = seated, 1 = straight); less than 1 keeps the body slightly curled.

knee_straighten.description: How far the knees straighten while lying (0 = bent as seated, 1 = straight).

lift_m.description: Height of the hips above the ground in metres at scale 1 while the body points are not known yet (the first frame of a figure).

max_tilt_deg.description: Largest tilt of the lying body towards the slope under it in degrees; on steeper ground it is lifted instead.

body_points.description: The sampled points of the lying body: bones of the figure rig and how thick the body is around them. The ground is read under each of them.

FigureBodyPoint.description: One sampled point of a lying body.

bone.description: Bone of the figure rig (its joint is the point).

radius_m.description: Thickness of the body around the point in metres at scale 1: the point stays at least this far above the ground.

FigurePoseCadence.description: Calm poses (W1697): how often a figure may change what it shows, in real seconds so fast forward does not turn idle variety into squats. An idle behaviour is held at least min_pose_s before the next idle behaviour; walking and core actions show at the next free frame; idle variety starts only after standing idle for idle_variety_after_s (before, the rest idle plays) and then changes every idle_slot_s (with idle_slot_spread and a phase per inhabitant); two figures never change their pose in the same frame, and two idle variety changes lie at least stagger_s apart; in a conversation (the inhabitant speaks to or is spoken to) only the conversation_idle behaviours play, no sitting or bending.

min_pose_s.description: Real seconds an idle behaviour is held at least before the next idle behaviour (core actions and walking are never held).

idle_variety_after_s.description: Real seconds a figure stands idle before idle variety begins; until then it plays rest_idle.

idle_slot_s.description: Real seconds one idle behaviour lasts before the next is drawn (± idle_slot_spread, phase per inhabitant).

rest_idle.description: Idle behaviour id (content/animation/library.json idle) a figure plays while it has stood idle only briefly.

stagger_s.description: Least real seconds between the idle variety changes of two figures (other changes only wait for a free frame).

conversation_idle.description: Idle behaviour ids allowed while the inhabitant is in a conversation (no sitting, crouching or bending).

max_changes_per_minute.description: Upper limit of idle variety changes per real minute and figure the presentation is tested against, at normal speed and at x16.

max_walk_changes_per_minute.description: Upper limit of changes the core drives (starting and stopping to walk, core actions) per real minute and figure the presentation is tested against. They follow the core without delay (no marching in place, short actions always show), so fast forward shows many more per real minute.

above_head_m.description: Height of the dots above the head anchor at scale 1.

font_px.description: Font size of one dot in pixels.

spacing_px.description: Distance between two dots in pixels (screen-facing).

period_s.description: Real seconds of one calm wave over the three dots.

model_height_cm.description: Height of the model at scale 1.

mesh.description: Hair mesh name in the figure models without the Hair_ prefix, or null for no hair (bald).
Mesh name in the figure models without the Cloth_ prefix.

color.description: Which clothing colour of the appearance record it takes.

covers.description: Body regions under this part (they take its colour).

items.description: Body region: forearm, thigh, lower_thigh or shin.

FigureSeat.description: Object types an inhabitant can sit on and the height of their seat above the ground.

types.description: Object type ids of content/objects (the drawn object under the figure).

seat_height_m.description: Height of the seat above the ground in metres.

FigureSitting.description: Seated poses and what they sit on.

seated_clips.description: Library clip ids that show a seated pose.

clip_seat_height_m.description: Height of the hips above the feet in the seated clips at scale 1 (the chair height of the clip).

seat_search_m.description: How far from the figure a seat object may lie (metres).

ground_knee_straighten.description: Share of straightening the knees when sitting on the ground (0 = clip as is, 1 = legs straight forward).

settle_m_s.description: How fast the hips move to the seat height (metres per real second).

FigureGreeting.description: Reaction to the player's voice (presentation only).

hear_radius_m.description: Inhabitants this close to the one spoken to hear the player too (metres).

react_s.description: Real seconds the hearers look and turn to the voice.

after_answer_s.description: Real seconds the speaker keeps looking at the voice after its answer.

ease_per_s.description: How fast the look turns in and out (weight per real second).

listen_clip.description: Library clip a standing hearer plays instead of its idle behaviour (no ducking).

wave_expressions.description: Expression ids of an answer that raise the arm to wave (procedural wave).

talk_s.description: Real seconds the mouth moves with a spoken answer.

express_s.description: Real seconds an answering figure shows the expression of its answer (one the model chose, or the quiet default of a wordless answer below) instead of its idle behaviour; 0 or omitted = only the wave is shown.

decline_expression.description: Expression shown when an inhabitant declines without words and the model chose none (TL #21712, D763 Z26: a reaction without words instead of a fixed sentence). Proposal value.

not_understood_expression.description: Expression shown when an inhabitant did not understand the player and the model chose none (TL #21712). Proposal value.

FigureSilhouette.description: The see-through silhouette of hidden figures.

color.description: Which colour of the inhabitant's appearance the silhouette takes.

min_cover_m.description: Only occluders at least this far in front of the figure count (its own clothes and arms do not).

FigureCrownFade.description: Fading of tree crowns near the line from the camera to a figure.

visuals.description: Object visual ids of content/look/objects.json whose crowns fade.

crown_height_m.description: Height of the crown's middle above the tree's foot (metres).

radius_m.description: Crowns closer than this to the camera-figure line fade (metres).

alpha.description: Opacity of a crown right on the line (it grows to 1 at the radius).

all_inhabitants.description: True: crowns fade for every inhabitant; false: only for the chosen (followed) one.

focus_within_m.description: While the camera is at most this far from what it looks at (following, a spot the player looks at), crowns between it and that spot on the ground fade too, so a thing under a tree is seen (A1599, finding D855). Omitted = only figures keep crowns faded; the wide view keeps its trees.
